Energetic hand-inked contours, dry brush marks and restrained scratch texture; clearly a drawn editorial illustration, never photorealistic. Fresh composition with a low driving posture rather than the reference's raised shooting pose. Strong readable typography and few elements.

Subject: exactly ONE REAL athlete, Tray Boyd III (トレイ・ボイド), chosen randomly from the fixed article's player list. His current official Yokohama Excellence profile photo has just been viewed. Depict the likeness from that current portrait: medium-brown skin, black thin medium-length twists/braids ending around the neck with a few framing the cheeks, broad plain black fabric headband across the forehead, thick full dark beard with connected moustache, strong wide eyebrows, slightly hooded dark eyes, broad nose, full lips and an oval face with a square lower beard outline. Lean athletic long-limbed 193cm build, not a bulky center. Face large enough to recognize and not obscured by the ball. Natural arm tattoo texture as abstract ink only, no readable tattoo lettering.
He wears a plain black/dark-green basketball jersey and shorts over a fitted black short-sleeve undershirt; remove ALL logos, lettering, sponsor marks, numbers, jewelry, emblems. His left hand controls an orange basketball during a powerful low forward drive, torso leaning and knees bent, other arm naturally balancing.
